feature.title: RNN family: consume weights supplied as runtime graph inputs

gold_patch.notes: The PR's inline insta snapshot tests and onnx-ir unit tests live inside src files and therefore ship with the gold patch; they are not used as oracle. The committed .onnx fixtures are treated as hidden test fixtures (they are the models the hidden tests load), packaged in tests/hidden-overlay.tar.gz (sha256 1e941d2ea5aab1fb36505c1eacf34c8620b671266b9787b6476e8c9924044a26).

components.reference: 4 hidden onnx-tests integration tests from PR #466 (expected sums from onnx.reference; reproduced bit-for-bit by onnxruntime 1.30 at authoring: Y/Y_h sums 0.1308653/0.0119344, 0.2429624/0.1401502, -0.5777385/-0.9212031, bidirectional runtime==static)
onnx v1.19.0 backend node tests: the 11 RNN-family rows promoted by the PR (expected outputs from the ONNX distribution), plus the full 830-row harness and drift checks as regression

onnxruntime 1.30.0 CPU on 24 authored RNN-family models (tests/gen_rnn_cases.py) emitted in upstream node-test format at verifier image build; layout=1 references computed on the layout=0 twin and permuted per spec, permutation checked against the distribution's *_batchwise outputs (max |delta| 1.2e-7) and onnx.reference where implemented (max 2.4e-7); onnx.reference itself is NOT used as reference because it ignores direction=reverse and lacks bidirectional
onnx2burn must reject mixed initializer/graph-input weight groups, sequence_lens and LSTM peepholes (non-zero exit) and accept a runtime-weight model

oracle.tolerance: burn Tolerance::default() = relative 0.5%, absolute 1e-5 (element-wise); PR tests: float_cmp (1e-5, 2 ulps) on sums
oracle.harness: the repository's own crates/onnx-official-tests build.rs harness (ModelGen -> generated #[test] per vendored dir) is reused for the differential rows, so no verifier-authored Rust is compiled into the submission's build

contamination.notes: PR merged 2026-08-21, 23 days before authoring (2026-09-13). Issue #458 and the PR body are public; the instruction restates the contract from the ONNX spec and the issue without the PR's design (GateLayout table, Param overwrite, lift_all_or_none). The 24 differential models and the reject probes are authored here and not public.

horizon.proxy: 11 non-test files across 2 crates (onnx-ir type inference + constant lifting; burn-onnx codegen for 3 operators), 1931 added / 505 deleted lines; interacting requirements: runtime-vs-static weight paths x 3 ops x 3 directions x 2 layouts x optional B/initial states x output subsets; corpus promotion with a drift gate; import-time rejection semantics

evidence: https://github.com/tracel-ai/burn-onnx/issues/458 (GRU/LSTM/RNN silently discard weights supplied as runtime graph inputs)
TODO.md roadmap item 6 at the base commit (scoreboard triage: every RNN row in the upstream suite fails for this reason)

Kept as alternate.
